thread:
deploy-bot: 🚀 Starting sandbox rollout: tag=v2.8.4-sandbox-rc commit=3f4a9bfa rollout_id=rb-2026-03-20 stages=[20,60,100]

alex_k: On it, watching request latency and error budget.

maya_sre: I'll wire up a quick dashboard and watch 5xx, p50/p95. alert if >1% 5xx or p95 > 2200ms.

deploy-bot: stage 1 (20%) complete — no errors observed, avg p95=180ms, 5xx=0.12% :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: progressing to stage 2 (60%)...

deploy-bot: stage 2 hit 65% — alert: 5xx spike detected (4.2%) from service=router, traces showing increased 502s from upstream.

luis_release: Noted. I'm seeing same in the traces. Suspect router change in this tag. Recommend pause and pin router to previous stable: router:stable-a21.

jon_p: +1 pause. If router is the only offender, pinning sounds safer than full rollback.

maya_sre: Agreed. Pausing rollout now and starting a canary revert for router. I'll run the revert then re-evaluate.

deploy-bot: Action: pausing rollout at 65% (rb-2026-03-20). Current live: 65%.

luis_release: Executing pin — patch: 
```bash
kubectl set image deployment/router router=registry.redwood/repo/router:stable-a21 -n sandbox
kubectl rollout status deployment/router -n sandbox
```

luis_release: Router revert applied, rollout status shows ready=3/3.

maya_sre: Observing metrics: 5xx dropping, current 5xx=0.18%, p95 back to 190ms. Looks good after ~45s.

alex_k: Can we resume bulk rollout to 100% or continue to 100 in smaller increments? Would prefer a controlled resume to watch other dependent services.

jon_p: Recommend resume to 80% first, then wait 5m, then 100%.

luis_release: I'll push a small hotfix to address router regression root cause, but safe to resume with pin in place. Pushing hotfix tag v2.8.4-hotfix1 commit=abc123ef

deploy-bot: resume requested by luis_release. Resuming rollout: stages now [80,100] for rb-2026-03-20 (override reason: manual pin + hotfix pending).

deploy-bot: stage -> 80% complete. Health: 5xx=0.15%, p95=195ms. No new alerts. :thumbsup:

maya_sre: Waiting 5m for stability window. Monitoring traces for router and ingress.

deploy-bot: final stage -> rolling to 100%...

deploy-bot: rollout complete: 100% applied. All readiness checks passed. 

deploy-bot: Summary: rollout_id=rb-2026-03-20 env=sandbox final_tag=v2.8.4-hotfix1 final_commit=abc123ef duration=~4m health=green notes="Paused at 65% to pin router to stable-a21, applied hotfix, resumed"

alex_k: Nice. Please add a short note to the release thread about the router pin and follow-up fix.

luis_release: Will add to release notes and file an action item to root cause the router regression (task: RL-472).

maya_sre: Closing monitoring loop. No perf regressions observed in the next 15m. If anything pops up I'll post here.

jon_p: Great job coordinating — saved a full rollback. :tada:

deploy-bot: Logged actions in release system and annotated rollout with pause reason and pins. CI artifact: https://ci.redwood.co/runs/1891234567

alex_k: thanks everyone :heart:
